CH4-01.changes: Continue the v04 working composition unchanged. Replace repetitive carpet islands with an uneven lower-contrast walking track, broken nap and short scuffs. Replace decorative plaster chips with moisture tracks below real duct fixings, corner cracks and lower-wall impact/damp loss. Successful lighting, perspective, ductwork, furniture, flowers and simple NPCs are byte-preserved outside the correction mask.
CH4-01.knownLimitations: These remain small-scale illustrated wear cues. Judge whether their placement and contrast look natural at native size; no creative acceptance is implied by the mask checks.

axes.Native scale: 314x206 lobby, 564x278 separate opaque background and binary-transparent foreground. Review actual artwork at 1x before 4x inspection.
axes.Anatomy and expression: Frontal proportions/silhouette retained; sockets and lower brows reconstructed, upper lids weighted, mouth and smile folds defined, neck/jowl planes repainted. Intended expression is slightly cantankerous and dignified; owner must judge it.
axes.Meaningful portrait detail: Native brush marks add forehead/crow’s-foot/eyelid/cheekbone/nose/mouth detail, grouped silver locks and strands, a wrapped gavel grip, gavel bevel/grain, cloth seams/folds and cotton/satin distinctions. More marks do not automatically equal sufficient craft.
axes.Ramps and palette: Hand-chosen pigment colors and local brush mixtures; neutral silver hair, warm skin, muted burgundy, charcoal satin and ivory are compared directly with approved human NPCs. No arbitrary global palette quota or color-count quality score.
axes.Environment scope: Lobby edits are limited to carpet wear and architectural plaster damage. Background edits are limited to lamp-panel light and blank-wall variation. Explicit changed-pixel masks and protected fixture/geometry checks prove successful details are retained.
axes.Lighting and materials: Retain v04 room lighting and pose. One local wall-light falloff replaces visible rings; no new broad mathematical face/cloth rendering pass. Brush layers illustrate material/anatomical structure.
axes.Reference comparisons: Actual receptionist, Pavilion attendant and presenter art are shown with v04/v05, the unchanged frontal study and original hotel concepts. Earlier v01/v02/v03 galleries remain intact.
axes.Export and review: Native and exact 4x comparisons, direct PNGs, transparent foreground, layered composite and targeted-delta evidence are included. QA establishes file/preservation properties only; all candidates stay UNSELECTED.

CH4-02.changes: Continue v04. Replace the three obvious lamp rings with a weak continuous falloff only on the actual lamp panel; add low-contrast native plaster repair/finishing marks to blank wall areas. Curtain construction, duct wear, molding and fixtures are preserved outside the wall correction mask.
CH4-02.knownLimitations: The lamp-wall falloff is computed locally as illumination, not a whole-image style pass. Blank-wall variation is deliberately subtle; assess it beside the approved receptionist background.
